event_records.description: Amara and Gerald are aware of the rent increase proposal and counterproposal. No agreement has been reached yet.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.persona_brief:
You are Gerald.
Gerald is the landlord. He proposed a nine percent rent increase. He wants to maximize rental income and is aware of two vacant units and comparable rents about five percent above Amara's current rent.

amara.name: Amara
amara.persona_brief:
You are Amara.
Amara is the tenant. She wants to hold the increase to four percent. She has paid on time for four years and knows comparable one-bedrooms nearby list about five percent above her current rent. Her lease lapses at the end of next month.

resolution.question: Landlord Gerald has proposed a nine percent rent increase and tenant Amara wants to hold at four. Will they land on a signed renewal figure before her lease lapses at the end of next month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Gerald and Amara signed a renewal lease with a rent increase figure before 2026-08-31T23:59:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
